content.comment_body: I have a [product_name] at home that I use to control my lights. I set up every input as a pushbutton, but after reading the program from the controller, all the inputs appear as switch buttons. Can anyone assist with this issue?

Are you referring to the block properties in the simulation? When you set an input to pushbutton mode within the block properties, it only impacts the simulation. In reality, hardware connections determine behavior—using a switch button results in switch functionality, and using a pushbutton results in pushbutton functionality.
I assumed the simulation settings would work the same in reality. Thank you for clarifying!

analysis.insight_summary: There was confusion due to differences between simulation and actual hardware behavior in [product_name]. While simulation lets users designate input blocks as pushbutton or switch, real operation relies on the physical type of input device used, not the software setting. This misunderstanding led the user to expect software settings would apply to the hardware directly.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected that selecting input types (pushbutton or switch) in simulation would directly affect the hardware behavior and program when retrieved from the controller.
